title: Material Overlay using Alpha Scissor not working for Shader, but works for StandardMaterial3D
body: ### Tested versions v4.5.1.stable.mono.official [f62fdbde1] ### System information Godot v4.5.1.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8180) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-11800H @ 2.30GHz (16 threads) - 15.75 GiB memory ### Issue description For MeshInstance3D, with opaque Material Override set, in Material Overlay section, when using StandardMaterial3D with Alpha Scissor, everything works correctly. However, when convert this material into a shader, **and restart the editor**, the material overlay no longer works My goal is to use Material Override as the base material for my mesh, then I use Material Overlay as a decal for my object. I want to use alpha scissor so that its still rendered in the depth texture for further post processing. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create a MeshInstance3D with new Mesh 2. Set Material Override with new StandardMaterial3D, no transparency, use easy to debug color (Red for example) 4. Set Material Overlay with new StandardMaterial3D, AlphaScissor with AlbedoTexture a random transparent background image 5. Duplicate the MeshInstance3D, and move it side by side with the original. 6. Inside the MaterialOverlay of the duplicated MeshInstance, right click and convert to ShaderMaterial. 7. Nothing changes, but after exit and reopen the Editor, the ShaderMaterial for Overlay stop working ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [scissor_alpha_overlay_2025-12-07_11-55-47.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24017063/scissor_alpha_overlay_2025-12-07_11-55-47.zip)
